en.linkedin:
I built a free Claude skill that turns your group chat into your favorite TV series.

Drop in the chat. CHATCOM casts your friends from how they actually text, writes the week into an episode, and makes it in the style you pick: sitcom, anime, 80s cartoon, true crime.

Why I built it: the best writing most of us will see this week is already in a group chat. The planner. The one who answers everything with "LOL". The friend who has been "tentative" since October. That is a cast. It just never had a show.

It runs as a Claude Code skill on your own computer, with your own keys. Open source, MIT.

Trailer and a full sample episode: https://b2b-content-systems.github.io/chatcom/
Version 0.1 is in development. Star the repo to get it first.

What would your group chat's show be called?

en.reddit_title: I'm building a Claude Code skill that turns a group chat export into a TV episode (trailer + full sample episode)
en.reddit:
CHATCOM is a Claude skill: drop in a WhatsApp group chat export, pick a show style (sitcom, anime, 80s cartoon, true crime), and get back an episode starring the people in the chat. It keeps a show bible, so running jokes carry from week to week.

Trailer and a full sample episode (fictional chat): https://b2b-content-systems.github.io/chatcom/
Repo (MIT): https://github.com/b2b-content-systems/chatcom

v0.1 is in development. It runs locally with your own keys and prints what goes where before any model call. Feedback on the format is very welcome.
